create_CCSDocument: create a CCSDocument model from a dictionary with document description, file info, and main text
export_CCSDocument_markdown: export a CCSDocument instance to a markdown string with configurable labels and delimiters
export_CCSDocument_document_tokens: export a CCSDocument instance to a DocumentToken formatted string with page location and content flags
resolve_CCSDocument_refs: resolve Ref objects in a CCSDocument's main text to their underlying Table, Figure, Equation, or Footnote items
validate_CCSDocument_dict: validate and normalize a dictionary input for CCSDocument with automatic abstract and author list conversion
